description: Addepar is an investment management platform for investors and advisors. Addepar’s cloud-based software allows an advisor unprecedented flexibility in the organization, aggregation, and presentation of client data through highly targeted preset and customizable metrics, increasing intimate knowledge about a client.

At AeroPay, we are reimagining the way money is moved in exchange for goods and services both in-person and online. Our payments solutions are designed to provide businesses with lower costs, faster settlement times, and enhanced security. We do this using our patented payments process that enables ‘smart bank transfers’ between businesses and their customers (C2B) or other businesses (B2B).
We make it possible to build a spend management solution in a fraction of the time, for a fraction of the cost. Leading platforms trust CapitalOS to power spend management for their customers.

Dream Security’s mission is to protect the most critical assets and increase their resilience against those cyber threats by leveraging deep learning algorithms to detect, contextualize, and respond to cyber risks across OT and IT networks.
EquityBee helps startup employees get the money they need to exercise their stock options before they expire by linking them to investors.

fintastic is building the next generation of FP&A platforms that seamlessly integrates and constantly adapts to the relevant organizational systems by using Al in an automatic exploratory process to derive the meaning and relationships of all the financial data.

At Giraffe, our vision is simple: we want to create a world where impact investing is the norm, and everyone has the power to drive positive change. We believe that by aligning financial investments with social and environmental values, we can create a better financial and sustainable future for all.
Healthee raises $50M to automate the mess of U.S. health benefits

HomeLight is the leading marketplace for finding real estate agents. HomeLight’s proprietary algorithm crunches hard-to-find home sales data to determine the best agents in a given neighborhood based on their actual past performance. For homebuyers and sellers, HomeLight identifies agents who are likely to save them thousands on a transaction. For agents, HomeLight is a fantastic, objective yardstick to showcase their skills to the world.

Loop Commerce enhances a big piece of the ecommerce business by empowering retailers with a solution that completely transforms the way their customers shop and gift online. As the first and only enterprise level solution, built based on the needs and requirements of top IR-500 retailers, Loop Commerce’s solution drives additional business, aids in customer acquisition, reduces cost of returns and exchanges, and increases customer loyalty.

We’re on a mission to ensure everyone can build inspiring careers. We partner with industry leaders, companies, and creators to train people for a tech career, and our students pay no tuition until they are hired.

Navan is a corporate travel management company for businesses and business travelers. Navan takes the pain out of corporate travel management with a complete solution that saves companies costs on business travel, and also rewards employees for their travel costs and behavior.
Next Insurance is an entirely online insurance company that offers tailored insurance products for entrepreneurs and small- to medium-sized businesses.

OpenGov is a reporting software that provides financial transparency and business intelligence to governments. This empowers senior executives to see trends, drill down to transaction-level details, and compare actual spending to the budget.

Papaya Global is a leader in global Human Resources (‘HR’) digitization. Papaya’s platform is transforming the entire global payroll process of manual paperwork, spreadsheets, and non-compliance risk into one automated interface.
RedKix is a software the powers team messaging through Redkix creates channels to collaborate with a team, customers, and partners.
SkyGiraffe connects data from enterprise servers and can build mobile apps across at unprecedented speed and scale (from months to days), while remaining entirely department and data source agnostic.
Sunbit Raises $355 Million Debt Facility

Tango Card provides leading incentive-delivery technology to organizations in the B2B space. Globally, enterprise companies use this technology to deliver an extensive catalog of domestic and global e-gift cards as part of consumer loyalty programs, sales incentive programs, health and wellness engagement, and employee recognition.

Tipalti provides the world’s most powerful global partner payments management platform. Tipalti automates the entire mass payments operations process, making it easy to pay any vendor, partner, or customer across 190 countries while ensuring all tax and regulatory requirements are met and enhancing the customer payment experience.
Venn is the world’s only platform and experience company focused entirely on Venn’s goal is to create Belonging for Neighbors and stronger business for landlord Partners.

Voca.ai, a leader in voice AI virtual agents for contact centers, uses Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Natural Voice Response (NVR) to provide a human-like ‘virtual’ agent for call centers. Voca agents can handle calls at any scale creating a better, frustration-free customer experience.
